# Draft:Swami Swarupananda Paramhansa Dev

----
Akhandamandaleshwar Sri Sri Swami Swarupananda Paramhansa Dev, born Bankim Chandra Gangopadhyay and known as "Babamani," was a prominent Hindu guru and social reformer who led the Character Building Movement and founded Morality Campaign Day. He has over 2.5 million disciples predominantly spread around Bangladesh and India.
